ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit in the attached figure, the lower common wire is node b; on the left there is a 20 V voltage source, whose upper terminal is connected through R3 to the upper central node; the central vertical branch goes from this upper central node through R1 and then connects to the upper terminal of an 8 V voltage source, and the lower terminal of the voltage source is connected to the bottom node b; on the right, from the upper central node through R2 it is connected to terminal a, and terminal a is open-circuited. Reasoning: Take b as 0 V. According to the source polarities in the figure, the upper terminal of the 20 V source is a 20 V node, and the upper terminal of the 8 V source is an 8 V node. Because terminal a is open-circuited, the R2 branch has no current, so there is no voltage drop across R2, and Va equals the voltage V of the upper central node. Write KCL for this central node: the algebraic sum of the current through R3 to the 20 V node and the current through R1 to the 8 V node is 0, namely (V - 20)/2 + (V - 8)/4 = 0. Simplifying gives 2(V - 20) + (V - 8) = 0, 3V - 48 = 0, so V = 16 V. Therefore Uab = Va - Vb = 16 - 0 = 16 V.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, \( R_1 = 4 \Omega \), \( R_2 = 5 \Omega \), and \( R_3 = 2 \Omega \). The open-circuit voltage \( U_{ab} \) between points \( a \) and \( b \) is ________V.

method.method_draft: Take node b as 0 V. From the image, identify the top of the 20 V source as a 20 V node and the top of the 8 V source as an 8 V node. Because a is open, the R2 branch carries no current, so Va is the same as the central top node voltage V. Apply KCL at that node using the given R1=4 Ω and R3=2 Ω, ignore R2 for current because it is open-ended, and solve for V. The resulting node voltage relative to b is the requested Uab.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中的电路以下方公共导线为节点 b，左侧有一个 20 V 电压源，其上端通过 R3 接到上方中央节点；中央竖直支路从该上方中央节点经过 R1 再接到一个 8 V 电压源的上端，电压源下端接到底部节点 b；右侧从上方中央节点经过 R2 接到端点 a，端点 a 开路。推理：取 b 为 0 V。按图中电源极性，20 V 源上端为 20 V 节点，8 V 源上端为 8 V 节点。因为 a 端开路，R2 支路无电流，所以 R2 上无压降，Va 等于上方中央节点电压 V。对该中央节点列 KCL：通过 R3 到 20 V 节点的电流与通过 R1 到 8 V 节点的电流代数和为 0，即 (V - 20)/2 + (V - 8)/4 = 0。化简得 2(V - 20) + (V - 8) = 0，3V - 48 = 0，所以 V = 16 V。因此 Uab = Va - Vb = 16 - 0 = 16 V。

method.method_draft: First remove the open R2-a branch from the current calculation, because no load is connected at a. Treat R3 and R1 as the only resistors in the closed loop between the 20 V and 8 V sources. Compute the loop current driven by the 12 V difference between the two source-top nodes through R3+R1. Then find the central node voltage by subtracting the drop on R3 from 20 V or adding the drop on R1 to 8 V. Finally set Va equal to this central node voltage and b to the bottom reference.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个20 V电源，其上端经过电阻R3连接到上方中间节点；该中间节点向右经过电阻R2连接到开路端a；中间节点向下经过电阻R1和一个8 V电源连接到底部公共节点，底部公共节点接到端b。推理：由于a端开路，R2支路无电流，因此R2上无电压降，Va等于中间节点电压。按指定方法，计算闭合回路时只考虑R3和R1，两个电源上端节点电位分别为20 V和8 V，电压差为20-8=12 V。回路电流I=12/(R3+R1)=12/(2+4)=2 A。中间节点电压可由20 V端减去R3压降得到：V=20-I·R3=20-2×2=16 V；也可由8 V端加上R1压降得到：8+2×4=16 V。以b为底部参考点，Uab=Va−Vb=16 V。
